# AMD Technical Report (as of 2026-11-16)

## 1. Data integrity notes
- Every indicator value from `get_indicators` (10 EMA, 50 SMA, 200 SMA, MACD, RSI, Bollinger upper and lower bands, ATR) matches the verified snapshot. I found no discrepancies.
- MACD signal (-14.55), MACD histogram (+5.37) and the Bollinger middle (517.33) come only from the snapshot. I did not pull separate time series for them, so I make no claims about when they crossed.
- I did not pull VWMA, so there is no volume-weighted trend confirmation. Volume is discussed only from the raw OHLCV rows.
- The 2026-11-16 volume (35,614,187) is the only non-rounded figure in the window and may be a partial or in-progress session. Treat the day's close (504.28) and volume as potentially provisional. This is an inference, not something the tools confirm.

## 2. Why these indicators
I chose eight indicators that cover different questions and overlap little:
- **Trend structure:** 10 EMA (short term), 50 SMA (medium term) and 200 SMA (long term).
- **Momentum:** MACD (with signal and histogram) and RSI.
- **Volatility and range:** Bollinger upper and lower bands, plus ATR for risk sizing.

AMD has swung hard in the last two weeks, so I weighted the volatility tools heavily.

## 3. What the price action shows
All figures are from the OHLCV data and the verified snapshot.

**Prior uptrend and peak.** AMD gapped up on 2026-09-21 (open 583.88, close 615.52 on 44.5M shares) and kept climbing. Its highest close in the recent 30-row window was 649.42 on 2026-10-06 (intraday high 658.52).

**Correction.** The decline from there was uneven, with lower highs and lower lows through October:
- Closes fell to 528.75 on 10-16 and 507.93 on 10-22. A rebound to 578.44 on 10-28 followed.
- The stock then dropped from 566.42 (10-29) to 504.80 (10-30) and 466.84 (11-02). The 10-30 volume was 39.7M, well above the roughly 15–20M typical of October.

**Capitulation-style low.** On 2026-11-05 AMD closed at 404.40 (low 402.10) on 71.2M shares, the heaviest volume in the whole six-month data set. RSI hit 29.75 that day, the only sub-30 reading in the lookback. That close is about 37.7% below the 10-06 close of 649.42.

**Sharp rebound.** Closes ran 449.04 (11-06), 508.58, 515.21, 552.90, then 585.30 on 11-12. That is about 44.7% above the 11-05 close in five sessions, on 45–55M shares per day.

**Reversal.** The rebound has since partly reversed:
- 11-13: 534.06, down from 585.30 after a 571.14 high and 520.01 low.
- 11-16: 504.28, in a 501.30–526.20 range.
- Two sessions erased about 81 points from the 11-12 close. Volume stayed elevated (49.2M on 11-13), so the sell-off had real participation.

## 4. Indicator readings

**Trend structure**
| Indicator | Value | Price relative to it |
|---|---|---|
| 10 EMA | 519.69 | Close is about 15 points below. It was 523.11 on 11-13, so the average is now turning down. |
| Bollinger middle (20 SMA) | 517.33 | Close is below. |
| 50 SMA | 555.09 | Close is about 9.2% below. The average itself is still creeping up (538.23 on 10-19 to 555.09), reflecting the strong September–October levels. |
| 200 SMA | 424.46 | Close is about 18.8% above. It has risen steadily (395.87 on 10-19). |

- The long-term trend is intact: price is well above a rising 200 SMA. The 11-05 intraday low (402.10) went below the 200 SMA, but the close (404.40) was only about 10 points under it (11-05 SMA: 415.00). I would call that a brief test, not a trend break.
- The medium and short term are weak. Price is below the 10 EMA, the Bollinger middle and the 50 SMA.
- The 10 EMA (519.69) and Bollinger middle (517.33) sit together at about 517–520. The 11-16 intraday high of 526.20 is just above that cluster. This is the nearest overhead reference zone, but I have no tool evidence that it has acted as resistance before.

**Momentum**
- **MACD:** -9.18 against a signal of -14.55, with a histogram of +5.37. MACD is above its signal but below zero. It improved from -30.20 (11-06) to -8.35 (11-13), then slipped to -9.18 on 11-16. That is a slight fade after the two down days, so the bullish momentum recovery is stalling. MACD went from +3.28 (10-19) to deeply negative, which confirms the medium-term momentum break during October.
- **RSI:** 46.73. It ran from 29.75 (11-05) to a peak of 57.48 (11-12) and has since rolled over. It is neutral, with no overbought or oversold signal. The oversold reading on 11-05 coincided with the volume spike and low. The failure to extend above 57.5 is mildly negative.

**Volatility**
- **Bollinger Bands:** 427.54 (lower) to 607.13 (upper), about 180 points wide. The upper band has come down from 677.35 (10-22) as the October highs roll out of the window. Price sits in the lower-middle part of the band, which is not an extreme.
- **ATR:** 41.28, about 8.2% of the close. It was about 26–27 through late October and peaked at 41.94 on 11-13. That is roughly a 55–60% increase in realised volatility within about two weeks.

## 5. Interpretation and scenarios (no trade decision)
**Overall read:** AMD is in a high-volatility consolidation after a sharp correction. A long-term uptrend is still intact, but the medium-term trend is down or unresolved and the rebound has failed to hold.

- **Bullish case:**
  - The 11-05 spike low on heavy volume, an RSI under 30 and a 45% rebound suggest selling exhaustion.
  - The MACD histogram is positive.
  - A sustained close above the 517–526 cluster would put the 50 SMA (555.09) and then the 11-12 high (594.00 intraday) in view.
  - The rising 200 SMA supports the long-term picture.
- **Bearish case:**
  - Price is below the 10 EMA, the Bollinger middle and the 50 SMA.
  - The rebound reversed on heavy volume.
  - MACD is still negative and RSI is rolling over.
  - A loss of the 11-16 low (501.30) would reopen the 11-09 to 11-10 area (the 468.21 low on 11-09 is the nearest recent data point).
  - Below that sit the 11-05 spike low (402.10) and the 200 SMA (about 424), the lower Bollinger Band (427.54) and the 11-06 low (433.30).
- **Most likely character:** wide two-way swings. With a 41-point ATR, daily moves of 5% or more have been routine recently, so single-day signals are unreliable.

## 6. Risk-management considerations
- A 1x ATR is about 41 points and 2x is about 83. A 2x ATR stop from the 504.28 close would sit near 421, close to the 200 SMA. This is arithmetic, not a validated level.
- Position size should be scaled down relative to October, when ATR was about 26–27. Holding dollar risk constant means roughly 35–40% fewer shares at the current ATR.
- Gap risk is real: the data show opens far from the prior close (for example 11-02, 11-05 and 11-09), so stops may not fill at the stated level.
- Wait for confirmation, such as consecutive closes above or below the 517–526 zone, instead of acting on single-session moves.

## 7. Summary table

| Latest close (11-16) | 504.28 (O 503.45, H 526.20, L 501.30); volume 35.6M, possibly provisional | Down about 5.6% on the day after a 534.06 close on 11-13 |

| Spike low | 404.40 close / 402.10 low on 71.2M (11-05) | Heaviest volume in the window; likely capitulation |
| Rebound high | 585.30 close (11-12), about 44.7% above 11-05 | Fully retraced by about 81 points in two sessions |
| 10 EMA | 519.69 | Price below; short-term bearish |
| Bollinger middle | 517.33 | Overhead zone together with the 10 EMA, about 517–520 |
| 50 SMA | 555.09 | Price about 9.2% below; medium-term bearish |
| 200 SMA | 424.46 | Price about 18.8% above; long-term trend intact |
| MACD / signal / hist | -9.18 / -14.55 / +5.37 | Above signal but below zero; fading after 11-13 (-8.35) |
| RSI | 46.73 | Neutral; down from 57.48 (11-12); 29.75 low on 11-05 |
| Bollinger Bands | 427.54 / 607.13 | Wide band; price in lower-middle |
| ATR | 41.28 (about 8.2% of price) | Up from about 26 in late October; size positions smaller |
